scope: Reconcile fit-only SPLINE wire structure, peer-reported parser behavior, and curve-semantic evidence; update existing PAR-22/7H/7I/7AB plan lane and implement the small local structural regression.

researchMethod.kind: Primary-source documentation and release-note review plus targeted local source inspection

sources.observation: Group 73 is listed as the control-point count, group 74 as the fit-point count (if any), and fit/control coordinates use distinct groups. Tangent components may be omitted. The page does not say group 73 is optional.
Fit-only SPLINEs are documented as supported and tested with AutoCAD 2010; documentation also warns that the same fit points admit infinitely many curves.
Documents fit-point construction and a CAD-style control-frame helper, while distinguishing that stored fit-point representation from explicit control-point geometry.

The CAD-like helper documents cubic reconstruction, chord parameterization, natural knot distribution, and endpoint derivative handling; this is peer documentation, not a normative Autodesk algorithm specification or a fresh CAD run.
Lists PR #1060 as updating IsPeriodic logic for fit-point splines; release note alone does not establish detailed behavior or a matching libdxfrw defect.

Open report describes a GDAL 3.9.0 Windows read error on a fit-point-only-looking SPLINE excerpt whose displayed fields omit group 73. The excerpt does not prove the omitted count is valid or establish a local failure.

assertions: exact imported fit point coordinates and tangent components
empty control-point, knot, and weight arrays
following LINE identity and coordinates remain aligned
writer output independently scanned for 73=0, 74=3, fit/tangent tags, and absence of groups 10/40/41

evidenceLimits: The local test establishes wire/model-field preservation, not curve evaluation or periodic fit-point semantics.
The displayed GDAL issue excerpt omits group 73; it is not used as a canonical positive input.
No current ezdxf/GDAL/ACadSharp executable was built or run, and no native CAD application was used.
No support claim or external J256/J260/J268/J284/J293/J295 status is promoted.
